title: Maximum Total Sum with Threshold Constraints
summary: Start at step one with total zero. Repeatedly choose an unused index whose threshold is at most the step, add its nums value, mark it used and advance the step. Stop when no index is eligible. Return the maximum total achievable through optimal choices.
